fixer.title: Folder Location and chat area: provider rows keep their identity, Close All keeps the last-used draft first across groups

introducer.title: Editor window: Explorer title, Worktrees submenu in the folder location picker, close buttons for the chat area and the empty editor area

cases.mechanism: In Single mode, moving a nonempty unsent composer between chat-part groups fired the ordinary close handlers, which captured its draft and appended it to _kept although the same composer stayed open in the target. Repeated moves accumulated duplicate entries without consuming them. _save/_writeStored exported attachments and serialized every entry, so m moves of a draft of serialized size d added O(m*d) serialization and stored bytes; editing between moves could also retain distinct historical snapshots.
cases.symptom: Statically established accumulation of duplicate kept drafts across moves, with increasing save-time allocation/serialization and persisted state; reloading also materializes the duplicate drafts. No measured timings are claimed.
cases.fixedBehavior: The added MOVE guards skip both draft capture and the kept-draft append for a transfer, preserving the live composer and retaining its draft only when it actually closes.
cases.evidence: EditorGroupView.doMoveOrCopyEditorAcrossGroups opens the same input in the target before closing it in the source with EditorCloseContext.MOVE (editorGroupView.ts:1603-1607); handleOnDidCloseEditor still fires close events but does not dispose an input open elsewhere (lines 719-746). The deleted base line 856 appended the captured draft unconditionally, and no move path pops _kept. The new guards at agentsChatPart.ts:862 and :875 bypass this. _captureClosingComposerInput/_sendableComposerInput (909-931) show that nonempty unsent drafts qualify; _writeStored (986-994) maps every kept entry through toStoredChatDraft and stringify, and newChatDraftState.ts:39-44 exports all attachments. The added movedD case at agentsChatPart.test.ts:1302-1311 corroborates retaining the moved draft only once. Blame identifies the introducing commit for the old append.
